description: Check the status of an asynchronous document created with docraptor_create_document({async:true}). Returns status (queued | working | completed | failed), and when completed a download_url / download_id / number_of_pages. DocRaptor API: GET /status/{status_id}.

status_id.description: The status_id returned by docraptor_create_document when async:true.

name: docraptor_get_document_status
title: Get async document status
